method: spherical-harmonic truncation of both models at T120 before scoring

truths.raob: radiosondes (explorer mirror): z500 and 850 hPa T, log-p interpolated
truths.era5: ERA5 (ARCO) 1.5° block means of the truncated fields, NH 20-80N
truths.era5-block: legacy: 1.5° block means of the raw 0.25° fields

acc_base.raob: each station's own IGRA day-of-year median (skewt-climo)
acc_base.era5: ERA5 1991-2020 ±7d day-of-year climatology (WB2), NH; none for t850
